regions.tonight: Mainly dry tonight with a mix of clear spells and mist patches. Lows of 4 to 7 degrees in a light variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Dry with sunny spells at first tomorrow. Cloud will build from the south through the afternoon. Light rain and drizzle will develop in southern parts and slowly move northwards through the evening. Highest temperatures of 13 to 16 degrees with moderate to fresh southeasterly winds developing.
